commands.label: write-claude-cli-setup-sh
commands.note: Write D:\claude_boot\claude_cli_setup.sh — primary deliverable (Claude CLI, not Go). Also run cmd-018 apkovl+ventoy.json if not already done.
commands.command: powershell -WindowStyle Hidden -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "New-Item -Force -ItemType Directory -Path 'D:\claude_boot' | Out-Null; $script = '#!/bin/sh`n# Alpine Linux - Claude CLI Setup`n# Primary autoboot deliverable`n# Usage: sh /media/usb/claude_boot/claude_cli_setup.sh`nset -e`necho "=== Alpine Claude CLI Setup ==="`n`n# Install packages`napk add --no-cache nodejs npm git curl`n`n# Install Claude CLI globally`nnpm install -g @anthropic-ai/claude-code`n`necho "Claude CLI installed. Starting..."  `nclaude`n'; [System.IO.File]::WriteAllText('D:\claude_boot\claude_cli_setup.sh', $script); Write-Output 'CLAUDE_CLI_SETUP_WRITTEN'; $vdrive = 'D:'; $ovl = "$env:TEMP\alpine_ovl3"; if (Test-Path $ovl) { Remove-Item $ovl -Recurse -Force }; New-Item -Force -ItemType Directory -Path "$ovl\etc" | Out-Null; New-Item -Force -ItemType Directory -Path "$ovl\root" | Out-Null; [System.IO.File]::WriteAllText("$ovl\etc\inittab", "::sysinit:/sbin/openrc sysinit`n::sysinit:/sbin/openrc boot`n::wait:/sbin/openrc default`ntty1::respawn:/sbin/agetty --autologin root tty1 linux`ntty2::respawn:/sbin/agetty 38400 tty2 linux`n::shutdown:/sbin/openrc shutdown`n"); [System.IO.File]::WriteAllText("$ovl\root\.profile", "clear; echo 'Alpine Claude CLI Boot'; echo '===================='; if command -v claude >/dev/null 2>&1; then claude; else sh /media/usb/claude_boot/claude_cli_setup.sh; fi`n"); Set-Location $ovl; tar -czf 'D:\localhost.apkovl.tar.gz' .; Write-Output 'APKOVL_OK'; New-Item -Force -ItemType Directory -Path 'D:\ventoy' | Out-Null; [System.IO.File]::WriteAllText('D:\ventoy\ventoy.json', '{"control":[{"VTOY_DEFAULT_MENU_MODE":"0"},{"VTOY_MENU_TIMEOUT":"5"}]}'); Write-Output 'VENTOY_JSON_OK'; Set-Location $env:TEMP; Remove-Item $ovl -Recurse -Force"
